content.title: VLT, Keck, and Gemini characterization of the temporarily captured flyby 2026 QQ$_8$
content.abstract: Very Large Telescope, Keck I, and Gemini North photometry of 2026 QQ$_8$ on November 7-21 gives Sloan Digital Sky Survey-equivalent colors $g-r=0.594^{+0.056}_{-0.053}$, $g-i=0.840^{+0.066}_{-0.065}$, and $i-z=-0.104^{+0.067}_{-0.057}$ mag. Apollo 17 basalt slabs 75075,197 and 71055,239 fit the colors (reduced $χ^2$ of 0.57 and 0.89). The Bus-DeMeo Sq- and K-type templates give reduced $χ^2=0.87$ and 0.90, respectively.
